searchText: MSRP $456,799. The New 2027 Thor Motor Coach Aria Diesel Pusher Model 3901. Features 400 Watt Additional Solar Charging System  This RV is approximately 39 feet 11 inches in length and features (3) slide-out rooms, drop down overhead bunk, fireplace, king size Tilt-A-View inclining bed, 21.4 cu-ft residential refrigerator, solid surface counter tops, stack washer/dryer and rear master bath w/ dual sinks. The Aria is powered by a Cummins 360HP diesel engine, Freightliner XC-R raised rail chassis, Allison automatic transmission Air-Ride suspension and features automatic leveling jacks with touch pad controls, touchscreen dash radio with GPS, tile floors and much more.
